about: What each entitlement id in catalog.json unlocks in the game. Cosmetic only: nothing here changes speed, grip, power, weight, wheel size, scoring, credits or XP, with one exception the owner made on 2026-10-16: car-oc-hyper, the OC Hypercar Founder Edition, is faster than any earnable car in Free Drive only (no clock and no rivals; Free Drive's score, best and board stay on the device, and its Unleashed runs are marked there and on run cards), and runs a race tune at or under the Rossini Corsa, with its ability off, in Races, Time Trial and Speed Survival (PROJECT_OC_MONETIZATION.md rule 3a). Every name is our own (Rossini, Vela, Orange County city and freeway names); no real brand. See PROJECT_OC_MONETIZATION.md.

status_key.ready: Works through a code path that exists today; needs only the entitlement check and the picker UI.
status_key.hook: Uses a parameter the renderer already has, but the player cannot choose it yet; needs a small override hook (an afternoon of Opus-class work). Test mode may sell it; live mode only once it is 'ready'.
status_key.build: Needs new art or a new system before it can be sold. Its catalog item stays available: false until it is built and checked in renders, except the Founder and supporter badges, the Founder frame and the Founders roll, which are built with the store itself; live mode sells those only once they are built.

free_baseline.note: Stays free for everyone and is never moved behind the store. Paid items must not duplicate anything here.
items: Every freeway, every exit start, every mode (Free Drive, Speed Survival, Races, Time Trial) and every race course
The four cars, earned with credits by driving: rossini-gt (starter), rossini-brio, rossini-corsa, vela-e
Each car's factory paint, wheels and interior
The free Garage palette from the UI pass (PROJECT_OC_UI_TARGET.md, U5): six paints per car and two rim styles per car
The three drivers (The Closer, The Ace, The Wrench), both presentations, five skin tones, their default looks and watches
The three abilities (Clear Path, Focus Time, Locked In)
The radio, the weather and time of day, Ultra Realism, run cards, the local leaderboard, achievements
Visiting the on-foot hangout (Lot 57) whenever it ships

paint_finishes.note: Material numbers for MeshPhysicalMaterial. The game's player-car paint today is paint() in src/preview/car-mats.ts, built by carMaterials in src/preview/car.ts: a metallic flake under clear coat (metalness 0.62, roughness 0.36, or 0.30 on the Vela E, clearcoat 1, clearcoatRoughness 0.03). Since the store pass (2026-10-16), PlayerCar.setPaint(hex, finish) takes these numbers (src/store/locker.ts reads them; gloss and satin drop the metallic flake, metallic and pearl keep it), and a colour with no finish still shows the factory finish. The status stays 'hook' until the seat, hood and chase renders of each finish are reviewed. The gloss numbers match the paint material in src/game/vehicle/Cockpit.ts, which the game no longer imports.

wheel_styles.note: The four store styles, each in the WheelStyle type in src/preview/car-wheel.ts. That type may also hold a car's own factory wheel that the store does not sell (the OC Hypercar's 'multi', from claude/hypercar): it is not listed here, no paid setup may use it, and tools/store-check-catalog.mjs accepts it only while a car in car-shape.ts wears it. All four are built at one size (WHEEL in car-wheel.ts) and PlayerCar scales them to each car's own axle (axle in car-shape.ts), so swapping a style keeps the car's wheel and tyre size: the look only (the physics reads cars.ts, not the wheel mesh). The rim hex is the 'rimPaint' material: the face on five and cl10; the barrel and sides on twin5, whose face is machined; the barrel and back on aero, whose turbine cover is its own 'aero' material, fixed at #2A2D33 in carMaterials (src/preview/car.ts), so an aero setup's rim hex needs the hook to colour the cover too. The caliper hex also colours cl10's centre-lock nut.

factory_wheels.note: From src/preview/car-shape.ts (SHAPES). Paid wheel setups never repeat a car's factory combination.

entitlements.name: Founder '26

entitlements.name: Founders run-card frame
entitlements.needs: An optional frame layer in src/ui/runCard.ts using the UI pass's --sunset-edge gradient (a UID theme token; not in this worktree at the 2026-10-16 check). The store pass (2026-10-16) drew the frame with its own sunset gradient (#FFB347 to #E8622C to #8E2C6B); move it to the UI token when that lands. Status stays 'build' until its render is reviewed.

entitlements.name: Rossini GT Spider
entitlements.stats: identical to rossini-gt (src/game/cars.ts): same mass, power, torque, gearing, drag, downforce and grip
entitlements.earnable: yes: in the showroom for credits, same as any car
entitlements.resale: a Spider bought with money cannot be sold in the garage for credits (profile.sell pays 60% of the credit price today, which would turn dollars into credits); one bought with credits sells as normal
entitlements.needs: An open-top body variant of the GT in car-body.ts and car-shape.ts, plus its cockpit without the roof.

entitlements.name: OC Hypercar Founder Edition
entitlements.earnable: no: sold only in the founder window (src/store/founder.json); owner mode drives it as No. 0000 · TEST on test builds

tunes.free_drive: Unleashed: the fastest car in the game, with its ability (Cold Thrust, Ground Lock, Thrust Hop); Free Drive's distance earnings are capped at the race tune's top speed
tunes.scored: Race tune in Speed Survival, Races and Time Trial: 231 mph, 3.12 s to 60, at or under the Rossini Corsa on every measured number, ability off (PROJECT_OC_HYPERCAR.md §5.3)

entitlements.garage: Added to the profile's vehicles outside the slot count while the signed-in account owns this grant (src/store/entitlements.ts, profile.setStoreCars); never sold back for credits; restored on sign-in like every other item
entitlements.needs: The car itself on the branch the store ships from: claude/hypercar's milestones (PROJECT_OC_HYPERCAR.md §8), oc-hyper in src/game/cars.ts with both tunes, the physics test at both handling extremes, the Free Drive earnings cap, and renders checked. Free Drive keeps a score (the distance), a saved best and a ranked device-only board (src/game/Game.ts endFreeDrive, the Personal bests panel in src/ui/App.tsx), so before available: true its Unleashed runs must be marked "Unleashed" on that board and on their run cards, or kept off the board (PROJECT_OC_MONETIZATION.md rule 3a; the store's copy says they are marked). The checker refuses available: true until oc-hyper is in cars.ts.

entitlements.name: Founder Edition plaque
entitlements.number: the serial the server assigns when the payment succeeds (migration 0002); never the device; No. 0000 · TEST is owner mode's; no entitlement, no number
entitlements.needs: The engraved-look canvas text on the car's sill and console, and the run-card badge beside the car name (PROJECT_OC_HYPERCAR.md §7).
